subject: DefaultMirrorManager fallback chain skips UNHEALTHY
test: DefaultMirrorManagerFalsifiabilityTest.fallback never invokes op when every mirror is UNHEALTHY (filter is load-bearing)
mutation: Removed `.filter { it.health != HealthState.UNHEALTHY }` from executeWithFallback in mirror/src/main/kotlin/lava/sdk/mirror/DefaultMirrorManager.kt
observed: java.lang.IllegalStateException: expected op to be invoked zero times (all mirrors UNHEALTHY); got touched=[https://a]
reverted: Restored the filter line by editing DefaultMirrorManager.kt back to its committed shape; full :mirror suite re-ran green (DefaultHealthProbeTest=4, DefaultMirrorManagerTest=4, DefaultMirrorManagerFalsifiabilityTest=1).
notes: Test design note: the production code blocks UNHEALTHY mirrors via two cooperating mechanisms — a (healthRank, priority) sort that demotes UNHEALTHY entries, and an explicit filter that removes them entirely. A two-mirror test where one is HEALTHY and one is UNHEALTHY is NOT falsifiable for the filter alone (the sort already places HEALTHY first). The rehearsal therefore uses an all-UNHEALTHY group, where only the filter can prevent op from being invoked; this isolates the filter as the load-bearing line and produces an observable failure when it is removed.
